period.description: The days the report reads: from the day the last janitor run ended, or the last 14 days when there was none, or the period the brief gives.

from.description: The first day read, YYYY-MM-DD in UTC.

to.description: The last day read, YYYY-MM-DD in UTC.

against.description: The days it is compared with: as many as the period, ending the day before the period starts.

from.description: The first day compared with, YYYY-MM-DD in UTC.

to.description: The last day compared with, YYYY-MM-DD in UTC: the day before the period's first.

report.description: The report, in markdown: what moved between the two periods, with the numbers `nemia stats` gave, a number nothing measured said as not measured, and the corrections proposed.

cards.description: One inbox card per correction proposed, filed by the step's check; none already in the inbox under the same title. Empty when nothing is worth correcting.

title.description: What to correct, in one line: the card's first line, which a later run reads to file no repeat.

kind.description: The correction: fence, an allow or a deny by name; body, a line in an agent's body; skill, a line in a skill; on-purpose, the refusal is meant and stays.

correction.description: The correction itself, exactly: the rule to add, or the line and the file it goes in.

evidence.description: The numbers behind it, as `nemia stats` gave them for the period and the one before.

agent.description: The agent the correction is about, by name; empty when it is about no one agent.

factory.description: The factory the card is started in.

workflow.description: The workflow the card is started on, by name.

verdicts.description: One verdict per card in play, read against the repository; the step's check refuses a card in play filed before the period's last day with none, and writes the report and the command that acts on each. Empty when the inbox has no card in play.

card.description: The card, by its name as `nemia inbox` lists it.

verdict.description: done, its work landed on the base; replaced, a later decision or card took its place; stale, facts it says have moved; standing, it holds as written.

why.description: Why, in a sentence or two: what was read, and for standing, whether it was read closely or untouched by the period.

commit.description: For done, the commit on the base that landed its work, by its hash; empty otherwise.

by.description: For replaced, the decision or the card that replaced it; empty otherwise.

facts.description: For stale, each fact that moved, in the order they are applied to the card's body; empty otherwise.

was.description: What the card says, quoted exactly as its body reads now, found once in it.

now.description: What it says once amended, what the repository says now.

why.description: Where the fact moved: the commit, the path or the decision.
